news.title: Border apprehensions tick up 25% as seasonal migration meets hardened enforcement
news.description: U.S. Border Patrol apprehended 8,268 people along the southwest border in March 2026, up from 6,598 in February, even as year-to-date crossings remain near multi-decade lows under asylum shutdown and deportation policies. Analysts attribute the month-on-month rise to milder spring weather rather than a reversal of the broader collapse in unauthorized crossings since 2024. Lawmakers remain deadlocked over separate funding for immigration enforcement agencies in a pending reconciliation package.
